metadata.title: Multi-condition ground truth for Bentazone (T10)
metadata.description: Structured truth matrix to validate the Tabui condition-comparison module with 38 synthetic low-resolution mzML files (full scan Q1, nominal mass, ESI+).

Parent.name: Bentazone
Parent.description: Starting target compound; degrades under the active photocatalytic and photolytic conditions, stable in the Reference.

TP1.name: Mono-hydroxylated intermediate
TP1.description: Primary reaction intermediate formed under all conditions with bell-shaped kinetics (maximum at t5, decline at t10).

TP2.name: Photo-oxygenation product
TP2.role: Photo-oxygenation marker (specific to O2 and Air)
TP2.description: Product that depends on dissolved oxygen; present only under O2 and Air, absent under inert atmospheres.

TP3.name: Anaerobic photolysis product
TP3.role: Anaerobic photolysis marker (specific to N2, Ar, He)
TP3.description: Anaerobic / deoxygenated photochemical degradation product; formed under N2, Ar and He, absent with O2.

TP4.name: Background contaminant / plasticiser
TP4.role: Background contaminant (removed by the blank filter)
TP4.description: Eluent/system artefact at constant concentration in all files (blank and standard included).

TP5.name: In-source fragment (ISF)
TP5.description: Fragment generated by thermal/electrical dissociation in the ESI source; co-elutes exactly with the parent and its height is about 18% of the parent's.
